messages:
Priya (CS): quick note from onboarding w/ ClearNorth — they praised throughput but called out 3 items that affect renewal probability. dropping raw notes.
Liam (CSM): summary: need campaign-level cost splits for finance, stronger webhook guarantees to avoid duplicate actions, and clearer per-route latency breakdowns. risk: medium.
Priya (CS): customer asks: 
- ability to tag requests with campaign identifiers for billing exports
- server-side retry with idempotency token and DLQ option
- p50/p95 latency per route in console or export
Priya (CS): they included an example header they send: `X-Campaign: north-fall` and said they currently re-try on 5xx causing duplicate downstream writes.
Dario (PM): putting this into triage. which of these is fastest to relieve customer pain?
Rae (Eng): cheapest win = pass-through of `X-Campaign` and include in usage export CSV. low effort (~1 sprint) for logging and export. per-route percentiles reuse metrics pipeline (~1 sprint). server-side retry + idempotency is heavier (routing + DLQ) ~2-3 sprints.
Liam (CSM): customer priority order = cost export (CFO), retries (ops), metrics (product). If we can ship campaign export ASAP they can reconcile costs and we buy time.
Priya (CS): action items: I will create feature ticket with acceptance criteria and include sample curl and CSV mapping. will ask for customer confirmation on header name.
OpsBot: created ticket RW-6305 "campaign-tag export MVP" assigned to product. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-6305
Dario (PM): Rae -- please add a short tech note on idempotency header format and DLQ semantics by EOD Thursday so we can scope retries work.
Rae (Eng): will post draft in RW-6305.
Liam (CSM): I'll tell the customer we can prioritize campaign tagging this sprint and share timeline.
Priya (CS): thanks all, will update thread after ticket is live and after sprint planning.
